title: Headless main-quest chain: the end slides (VEnding) from VHDHouseBattle 100 (House ending) through the narrator's SayTo chain to FadeToCreditsTimer and ExitGame; docs/handoff/mq-walkthrough-2026-10-27.md

actions.text: Joins where All or Nothing's last stage, 100 (House told of the victory), sets the story-event global to 63 (the House ending) and starts VEnding. Set here directly so this chain runs alone.

actions.label: player moved to the slideshow marker

actions.text: VEnding's quest script moves the player into the slideshow room; the player lands in its trigger (OnTriggerEnter: physics sensors stand in), which starts the narrator's first SayTo (VEndingIntro).

From here the narrator's object script chains every slide: each SayToDone block picks the next slide topic by the ending and the world's state, up to VEndingConclusion, whose SayToDone starts FadeToCreditsTimer; its script fades out after 7.8 s and calls ExitGame. Voice lengths time the lines (the runner reads the voice files' lengths). At most 30 minutes of game time.

actions.label: milestone: VEndingConclusion said, credits timer started
